Great UI - Accessible React & Tailwind Components

name: Great UI
summary: 50+ copy-paste animated React components — cards, text effects, transitions, menus — built with TypeScript, Tailwind and Motion.
description: An open-source collection of copy-paste React components grouped into seven sets: social cards, visuals, typography, page transitions, theme transitions, buttons, and layout & cards. Components include animated text effects (word focus scroll, blur scroll reveal, split line fly in), ten page transitions, four theme transitions, a terminal loader, floating dock and gooey menus, device mockups, a marquee carousel, avatar stack, timeline, accordion and social cards. Built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4 and Motion; MIT licensed.
contains: 50 components in 7 groups: social cards, visuals, typography, transitions, buttons, layout & cards
typography set: word focus scroll, blur scroll reveal, split line fly in, text reveal, scrambled install command
10 page transitions incl. CrossBlur, Venetian Blinds, Cascade, Sine Wave, Pixel, Sweep and Curtain
4 theme transitions: Blur Fade, Split, Circular and Swipe
visuals include terminal loader, floating dock menu, radial gooey menu, macbook and mobile mockups
copy-paste code you own; light and dark modes with high-contrast variants
stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion; MIT license
